The node appears to split into four public-market mappings: direct OPM/enrollment operations, regulated student-finance/payment infrastructure, AI marketing/data activation, and trusted credential/program distribution.

node: University enrollment, AI discovery, advising, and lead-conversion stack
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around university enrollment infrastructure rather than generic online-learning demand. The strongest direct public mapping is Grand Canyon Education as a reference OPM/enrollment-operations provider. The more underfollowed lane includes Nelnet, where education technology, payments, loan-servicing systems, and enrollment services may form a compliance-heavy infrastructure layer; and Zeta Global, where education enrollment may be a vertical use case inside an AI marketing/data platform rather than an obvious edtech label. Coursera is included as a reference distribution/program-data platform because it connects university and industry partners to learners, but its relation to university enrollment conversion is less direct than LOPE. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
